title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas finite-volume and case-driven freestream/viscosity exist; source and report contain BDF2 physical-time residual.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:135–153 and mesh_global/partition code read CGNS, use METIS and create rank-local mesh with owned/ghost cells.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:455–480 adds face and physical-time contributions with volume weighting; norms use MPI reductions at :578–593.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Production AUSM+-up and optional low-Mach Rusanov are described in report.tex:112–115 and present in numerical source; no independent flux-order test.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Wall/farfield treatments and boundary-value surface output exist; observed large spurious lift on nominally symmetric laminar cases limits confidence.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Report.tex:94–97,290 explicitly says all viscous and supersonic runs use first order; inviscid low-Mach runs also use a first-order wall-adjacent layer.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-limited second-order path exists, but disclosed production first-order modes disable reconstruction in most cases.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:375–388 integrates tangential shear and pressure separately; first-order laminar solutions exhibit substantial spurious lift and force drift.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS implicit march exists, but solver.cpp:1015–1022 accepts residual stall without checking force stability; Re20 force tails contradict a stable plateau.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1093–1096,1154–1173 tests total residual relative to per-step reference with absolute fallback; run reaches t300 but wake is steady and lacks required shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only global mesh scope, METIS/local partition and neighbor halos exist. Original np1/2/4/8 continuation records agree closely at common step, though underlying flows are not physically converged.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
